title: What Is Your Enneagram Wing Type?
description: Answer 12 insightful questions to discover your Enneagram wing type—the subtle influence that shapes your personality!

questions.text: When you make a decision, you usually...

options.text: Follow your internal values and principles
Consider how it affects the people you care about
Think about the outcome and what you can achieve
Go with what feels right in the moment

questions.text: When someone needs help, you typically...

options.text: Jump in immediately and take charge
Offer emotional support and listen

results.title: 1w9 - The Idealist
results.description: You are a Type 1 with a 9 wing, making you The Idealist. You have a strong sense of right and wrong, but you're also calm, easygoing, and peacekeeping. You strive for perfection while maintaining an inner serenity. You're the moral compass who wants to improve the world without causing conflict.

results.title: 1w2 - The Advocate
results.description: You are a Type 1 with a 2 wing, making you The Advocate. You have a strong moral compass combined with a desire to help others. You're principled and principled, driven to make the world better through both your ideals and your caring nature. You're the supportive reformer who leads with compassion.

results.title: 2w1 - The Servant
results.description: You are a Type 2 with a 1 wing, making you The Servant. You're naturally helpful and caring, but you also have a strong sense of right and wrong. You want to help others but also maintain your values. You're the altruistic helper with a principled heart.

results.title: 2w3 - The Host
results.description: You are a Type 2 with a 3 wing, making you The Host. You're warm, caring, and ambitious. You want to help others while also achieving success. You're the accomplished helper who knows how to get things done and make people feel valued.

results.title: 3w2 - The Charmer
results.description: You are a Type 3 with a 2 wing, making you The Charmer. You're ambitious and image-conscious, but also genuinely caring and interpersonal. You want to succeed while building meaningful connections. You're the charismatic achiever who wins people over.

results.title: 3w4 - The Professional
results.description: You are a Type 3 with a 4 wing, making you The Professional. You're ambitious and success-driven, but also introspective and creative. You want to stand out while achieving your goals. You're the distinctive achiever who values authenticity in success.

results.title: 4w3 - The Aristocrat
results.description: You are a Type 4 with a 3 wing, making you The Aristocrat. You're introspective, emotional, and image-conscious. You want to be unique while also achieving recognition. You're the dramatic creative who knows how to present their vision.

results.title: 4w5 - The Bohemian
results.description: You are a Type 4 with a 5 wing, making you The Bohemian. You're introspective, emotional, and analytical. You want to understand the deeper truth while expressing your individuality. You're the depth-seeking creative who values knowledge and authenticity.

results.title: 5w4 - The Iconoclast
results.description: You are a Type 5 with a 4 wing, making you The Iconoclast. You're analytical and introspective, with a touch of emotional depth. You want to understand the world while maintaining your unique identity. You're the eccentric thinker who bridges logic and emotion.

results.title: 5w6 - The Problem Solver
results.description: You are a Type 5 with a 6 wing, making you The Problem Solver. You're analytical and logical, but also loyal and security-conscious. You want to understand the world while staying prepared. You're the reliable analyst who values competence and security.

results.title: 6w5 - The Guardian
results.description: You are a Type 6 with a 5 wing, making you The Guardian. You're loyal and security-oriented, but also analytical and knowledge-seeking. You want to be prepared while understanding the underlying systems. You're the vigilant thinker who trusts competence.

results.title: 6w7 - The Buddy
results.description: You are a Type 6 with a 7 wing, making you The Buddy. You're loyal and security-oriented, but also spontaneous and optimistic. You want to be prepared while enjoying life's adventures. You're the fun-loving loyalist who balances caution with joy.

results.title: 7w6 - The Entertainer
results.description: You are a Type 7 with a 6 wing, making you The Entertainer. You're spontaneous and optimistic, but also loyal and group-oriented. You want to have fun while having a safety net. You're the engaging adventurer who values connections.

results.title: 7w8 - The Realist
results.description: You are a Type 7 with an 8 wing, making you The Realist. You're spontaneous and optimistic, but also assertive and decisive. You want to enjoy life while taking charge. You're the bold adventurer who combines fun with action.

results.title: 8w7 - The Maverick
results.description: You are a Type 8 with a 7 wing, making you The Maverick. You're assertive and powerful, but also spontaneous and fun-loving. You want to be in control while enjoying life's adventures. You're the adventurous challenger who leads with energy.

results.title: 8w9 - The Bear
results.description: You are a Type 8 with a 9 wing, making you The Bear. You're assertive and powerful, but also calm and peacekeeping. You want to be in control while maintaining harmony. You're the balanced challenger who commands respect gently.

results.title: 9w1 - The Dreamer
results.description: You are a Type 9 with a 1 wing, making you The Dreamer. You're peaceful and easygoing, but also principled and idealistic. You want harmony while striving for improvement. You're the gentle idealist who wants a better world.

results.title: 9w8 - The Mediator
results.description: You are a Type 9 with an 8 wing, making you The Mediator. You're peaceful and easygoing, but also assertive and powerful. You want harmony while standing your ground. You're the strong peacemaker who balances calm with strength.
